parsed.rationale: Although the two types share structural shape (both are `type-alias-object` with `shared_field_count: 1` and no fields listed), they carry distinct domain names — `TextHeightPreferenceKey` in `app:WatchXYC` / `WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift` and `ScrollOffsetPreferenceKey` in `app:iOS` / `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/Playcut Detail/PlaycutRowView.swift`. SwiftUI `PreferenceKey` conformances are typically tiny value-type stubs whose structural similarity is an artefact of the pattern, not shared logic; each key encodes a semantically distinct preference (text height vs. scroll offset) used in unrelated UI contexts on different platforms (watchOS vs. iOS). Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated concerns and provide no meaningful reduction in code.
